data.title: 埃列什基伽勒 · 泳池边的蓝色休暇·「冥界没有泳池……这是我偷偷造的」
data.description: 【冥界秘造泳池·夏日】黑蓝褶边的比基尼衬着女王窈窕的身段，她坐在泳池边把双腿浸在水里——这座泳池是她瞒着所有神明偷偷造的。水面的幽光映着她的红瞳——「冥界没有泳池，所以我偷偷造了一个。……这个地方，除了你，谁都不知道哦。要、要替我保密哦？」
data.action: 池边浸腿坐水光里，褶边比基尼红瞳认真
data.lighting: 池水幽光与照明球的柔光
data.camera: medium shot, sitting poolside, feet in water, secret-share mood
data.promptProse: Ereshkigal sits at her hidden underworld pool with lower legs in the water and both hands on the rim, red eyes attentively sharing its quiet shelter. Her black-and-blue frilled swimsuit, light sarong and blonde twintail ribbons remain clear in the horizontal medium view. The pool curves into the dark cavern behind. Floating light orbs softly illuminate her face and rim, while the water's blue glow reflects beneath her hands and across nearby stone.
